summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by NOVONIX Ltd, a foreign private issuer, providing an Appendix 3G notice to the ASX regarding the issuance of 1,371,566 unquoted share rights to directors as part of director remuneration, following shareholder approval at the Annual General Meeting on April 15, 2026. No cash consideration was involved. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are present.
